This is the seventh chapter of the [[Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!]] manga. It was first published in the January 2022 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'', released on November 20, 2021.<ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20230817234908/https://www.bookshop-ps.com/bsp/bsp_magcode?sha=1&sho=1385901122 ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' January 2022 issue | Shogakukan BOOK SHOP] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20220528032215/https://corocoro.jp/news/313288/ ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' January 2022 issue | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kemonmon/status/1462707134991269888 Kemon Kawamoto on X (Twitter)] (Japanese)</ref> It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on July 15, 2022.
